title: Negative Visualization
short_description: Anticipate a possible difficulty and consider a prepared, principled response.
use_when: A foreseeable setback feels vague or overwhelming.
A plan depends on everything going smoothly.
not_ideal_when: Imagining setbacks becomes repetitive without adding preparation or clarity.
example_user_queries: I keep worrying about what could go wrong.
How do I prepare for a difficult conversation?
I freeze when a presentation goes off script.
Small disruptions ruin plans I was looking forward to.
I want a backup plan without obsessing over disasters.
I expect trips to go perfectly and get frustrated when they do not.
How can I think about possible failure constructively?
I take familiar routines for granted until they change.

title: Adversity as Training
short_description: Use an unwelcome situation to practise a specific quality of character.
use_when: An unavoidable difficulty feels pointless or personally unfair.
A setback leaves meaningful choices about conduct.
goals: Give effort a purpose beyond the outcome
not_ideal_when: The framing pressures someone to find benefit in suffering.
Endurance is being used to avoid a necessary boundary or change.
example_user_queries: This setback feels completely pointless.
How can I stay fair when someone treats me badly?
I want to respond well to harsh criticism.
How do I find a constructive way through an unavoidable problem?
I feel punished whenever things go wrong.
How can I practise patience without letting people walk over me?
The project is already a mess and I have inherited responsibility.
Can a failed effort still have value?

title: Dichotomy of Control
short_description: Distinguish your contribution from an outcome that depends on more than your choices.
use_when: Attention is fixed on other people’s decisions or approval.
Responsibility for a contribution is confused with a guarantee of success.
not_ideal_when: The distinction is used to dismiss obligations or evade reasonable preparation.
example_user_queries: I keep checking whether they have replied.
I cannot stop worrying about the hiring decision.
I take every failed project as proof I did something wrong.
How do I care about an outcome without needing a guarantee?
I apologized but they have not forgiven me.
How much responsibility should I take for this result?
I spend more time worrying than doing what is available.
I cannot make someone understand my intentions.

title: Pause Before Assent
short_description: Examine an impression before accepting its interpretation or acting on its urgency.
use_when: An ambiguous event seems to demand an immediate reaction.
Anger, approval, or temptation gives an interpretation unwarranted certainty.
goals: Improve the basis of a judgment
not_ideal_when: Further delay becomes avoidance after sufficient information is available.
example_user_queries: A short message makes me assume the worst.
I reply angrily and regret it later.
I cannot tell whether a colleague is being dismissive.
An exciting purchase suddenly feels essential.
How do I check the story I am telling myself?
I want to react less defensively to criticism.
I take praise as proof that I must be right.
I keep replacing an unpleasant assumption with a comforting one.

title: Voluntary Discomfort
short_description: Choose a modest inconvenience to examine dependence on a particular comfort.
use_when: A preference has begun to feel like a necessary condition for contentment.
A small, chosen experiment could clarify what a convenience actually provides.
not_ideal_when: An experiment would compromise a practical need or impose costs on others.
Difficulty has become a contest or a measure of personal worth.
example_user_queries: A minor inconvenience can spoil my whole morning.
I worry that I depend too much on expensive conveniences.
How do I tell whether I need something or just prefer it?
I keep wanting to replace things that still work.
I want to enjoy simple things without rejecting comfort.
I feel restless without my usual entertainment.
How can I make a small experiment with living more simply?
I turn every challenge into a test of toughness.

title: The View from Above
short_description: Widen attention across space or time to restore proportion and recognize other lives.
use_when: A local status concern occupies the whole field of attention.
A wider context could clarify significance or neglected responsibilities.
not_ideal_when: The wider perspective dismisses suffering or replaces attention to a concrete responsibility.
example_user_queries: I cannot stop replaying an embarrassing remark.
A promotion decision feels like a verdict on my entire life.
Office politics has taken over my attention.
How can I get perspective without pretending nothing matters?
I forget that other people have lives outside their relationship with me.
A small disagreement feels permanent.
I want to see my problems in a wider context.
How do I stop making every delay about me?
